title.zh: 伊朗重申霍尔木兹海峡将保持关闭，并称将很快封锁「非法」航道

current_state.zh: Iran reiterated that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until its demands are met, with an IRGC adviser saying Tehran will soon shut down 'illegal' shipping lanes in the strait.
